subject: HelioBank compliance commitments + next actions (SOC 2, retention, DPA)
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@heliobank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adam Ruiz <adam.ruiz@heliobank.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + artifact ask from today

Jonas,

Thanks again for the call earlier — that was helpful. Wanted to capture HelioBank's immediate asks so we have alignment before we bring procurement into the loop. High-level notes from our side: 

- Pain points: unpredictable per-token costs for bursty traffic, lack of audit logs tied to user IDs for regulatory reporting, and questions about retention of request/response data for customer dispute investigations.
- Goals: a predictable SLA-backed integration for production (latency ~150ms p50 for auth flows), ability to retain and export audit logs for 12 months, and contractual DPA language that covers encryption & subprocessor transparency.

For next steps we'd like: 
1) A short list of the specific artifacts Redwood can provide (SOC 2 type II scope, sample audit-logs, retention policy options).
2) A DPA template and proposed timelines for procurement review.
3) A follow-up technical deep-dive with security + infra (30–45m) to review audit log schema and pen test approach.

Can you confirm what you can share ASAP and propose dates for the deep-dive? Adam — looping you for availability and procurement intro.

Thanks,
Asha

--
Asha Patel
Head of Compliance, HelioBank
asha.patel@heliobank.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@heliobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Adam Ruiz <adam.ruiz@heliobank.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + artifact ask from today

Thanks for the clear summary, Asha — appreciate the concise priorities. Below is what we can commit to immediately and the proposed timeline. I've kept the notes brief so you can forward to your procurement/security teams if helpful.

Summary of what Redwood will provide this week:
- SOC 2: Redacted SOC 2 Type II summary (scope: infrastructure + data handling) — we can provide within 48 hrs. (attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q4.pdf)
- Audit logs: Sample export of anonymized audit-log rows with the schema and a short README explaining fields/retention (attachment: audit-log-sample-HelioBank.csv)
- Retention options: Draft retention matrix (30/90/365 days) and recommended default (365 days for audit logs, 90 days for request bodies by default; configurable by contract).
- DPA: Standard Redwood DPA template for review (attachment: DPA-template-Redwood.docx). We can highlight sections customers typically redline (subprocessors, deletion windows, and incident timelines).

Proposed next steps & owners:
- Technical deep-dive (30–45m) — Laura Bennett (security lead) and I will attend. Proposed windows: Wed 2027-06-09 09:00–10:00 PT or Thu 2027-06-10 11:00–12:00 PT. Please let us know which works for you and Adam.
- Procurement review: We'll send the DPA now; ask procurement to flag must-have redlines and target a 2-week review cycle.
- Pen test / third-party assessment: We run internal pen tests quarterly and have vendor reports — we'll share the summary and point-of-contact during the deep-dive.

Action items (short):
1) Jonas: upload SOC2 snapshot + audit-log sample + DPA (sent as attachments with this thread) — ETA: today EOD.
2) Laura: prepare 15-min security overview for deep-dive (audit-log schema, access controls, retention enforcement).
3) HelioBank (Asha/Adam): confirm deep-dive time, and share procurement contact + any specific contractual must-haves.

If helpful I can also include a short one-page matrix mapping your pain points to Redwood controls (will share in the meeting).

Cheers,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0198

[Attachment stubs included: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q4.pdf, audit-log-sample-HelioBank.csv, DPA-template-Redwood.docx]
From: Adam Ruiz <adam.ruiz@heliobank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@heliobank.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + artifact ask from today

Jonas / Asha — thanks. Wed 09:00 PT on the 9th works for our security/infra folks. We will invite: myself, Asha, and our security engineer (Paul Nguyen) — is Laura the best contact for the technical walk-through?

Two clarifications from procurement/security before the session: 
- Can Redwood provide a brief statement of where audit logs are stored (region) and whether logs contain PII by default? We need to demonstrate data localization for a subset of accounts.
- For pen tests, do you share the vendor name and an executive summary or full report? We typically request a summary plus remediation timelines.

Procurement contact is: Diane Morales <diane.morales@heliobank.com> — I'll loop her into the invite.

Thanks,
Adam

--
Adam Ruiz
Sr. IT Procurement, HelioBank
adam.ruiz@heliobank.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Ruiz <adam.ruiz@heliobank.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@heliobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + artifact ask from today

Thanks Adam — confirmed for Wed 2027-06-09 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Laura will lead the walk-through and Paul is a great attendee for the audit-log discussion. Diane — welcome, we'll include procurement-relevant slides and the DPA template for review.

Quick answers to your questions so you have them ahead of the meeting: 
- Audit log storage: Primary storage is in us-west-2 with encrypted-at-rest S3 buckets and restricted access via role-based IAM. We can discuss a dedicated logging bucket or cross-account access patterns if HelioBank needs a separate retention/export flow. Logs do not contain PII by default; request/response bodies are redacted unless you opt-in for full retention in the contract.
- Pen tests: We provide an executive summary of third-party pentest results and a remediation tracker. Full reports are typically shared under an NDA; we can provision a summary in the deep-dive and discuss NDA cadence for full reports.

Attachments re-sent with this reply for convenience. If procurement would like, we can prefill the DPA with HelioBank's legal contact to speed review.

See you on Wed — agenda we'll run: (1) 10m security overview, (2) 15m audit-log schema & export options, (3) 10m DPA + contract touchpoints, (4) 5m next steps and timeline.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
